body: `change` is a native event. You should name the emitter something else.
Note: the main problem here is that we've got no way of distinguishing DOM events vs. directive outputs. This is already tracked in #4593 / #4059
Is it written somewhere in the documentation? I can not find.
it doesn't help that your styleguide uses `change` @Outputs in several examples: https://angular.io/guide/styleguide#decorate-input-and-output-properties

issue.title: docs: edit EventEmitter name in styleguide
